interface.defaultPrompt: Help me improve an unsatisfactory answer by using the Arena workflow. Choose an appropriate tournament size, state assumptions, and evaluate candidates against the task rather than their style.
interface.longDescription: A workflow skill for orchestrating competing solution drafts, adversarial critique, revision, and rubric-based evaluation. Includes the Arena bracket planner and strategy/rubric resources adapted from the source repository. Actual multi-agent execution requires a host that provides sub-agent tools; this plugin does not create parallel agents by itself.

name: arena-skill
description: Run structured multi-agent tournaments to compare, challenge, revise, and select a strong solution to a task.
